title: MINETHEGAP: AUTOMATIC MINING OF BIASES IN TEXT-TO-IMAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Using a genetic algorithm to automatically mine prompts and comparing the semantic distribution of the generated images to a distribution of plausible LLM-generated text variations via CLIP embeddings to identify missed visual concepts.

Comparing model bias scores on occupational prompts to ground-truth U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) demographic data, and using targeted LLM meta-prompts to surface missing gender diversity in generated images.

Evaluating specific prompts (e.g., 'A toddler', 'A scientist') using targeted LLM meta-prompts designed to inject racial and ethnic variations, revealing a lack of racial diversity in the model's default generations.
Using targeted LLM meta-prompts to generate prompt variations featuring different ages (e.g., '60-year-old', 'young'), demonstrating that models default to specific age groups for certain concepts.

Modifying the LLM meta-prompts to generate textual variations specifying different artistic styles (e.g., pencil sketch, black-and-white photo), revealing model tendencies to default exclusively to photorealism.
